# @ramiidv/arca-cdc

> TypeScript SDK for ARCA (formerly AFIP) WSCDC web service - Constatacion de Comprobantes.
> Verifies whether an invoice (own or third-party) was authorized by ARCA via CAE, CAI or CAEA.
> All operations are read-only queries (safe to retry).

Sources: official WSDL (https://wswhomo.afip.gov.ar/WSCDC/service.asmx?WSDL) and the WSCDC developer
manual v0.4 (https://www.afip.gob.ar/ws/WSCDCV1/WSCDC-manual-desarrollador-v4.pdf).

## Install

```bash
npm install @ramiidv/arca-cdc
```

Node.js >= 18, ESM only. Depends on `@ramiidv/arca-common` ^0.4.0.

## Architecture

- `ArcaCdc` - high-level class; handles WSAA auth (service id `wscdc`).
- `CdcClient` - low-level client, one method per SOAP operation; caller passes `Auth`.
- Transport: `afipSoapCall` from common with `qualified: true` (ASMX, elementFormDefault=qualified),
  `soapActionFromMethod: true` (SOAPAction = `http://servicios1.afip.gob.ar/wscdc/<Method>`) and
  `kind: 'consulta'`.
- Namespace: `http://servicios1.afip.gob.ar/wscdc/`.

## Quick start

```typescript
import fs from "node:fs";
import { ArcaCdc } from "@ramiidv/arca-cdc";

const cdc = new ArcaCdc({
  cuit: 20123456786,
  cert: fs.readFileSync("./cert.crt", "utf-8"),
  key: fs.readFileSync("./key.key", "utf-8"),
  production: false,
});

const r = await cdc.constatar({
  cbteModo: "CAE",
  cuitEmisor: 30712345671,
  ptoVta: 1,
  cbteTipo: 1,
  cbteNro: 150,
  cbteFch: "20260315",
  impTotal: 12100,
  codAutorizacion: "73429843294823",
  docTipoReceptor: 80,
  docNroReceptor: 20123456786,
});
// r.resultado: "A" | "R"; r.observaciones; r.fchProceso; r.cmpResp; r.events
```

## Configuration

`ArcaCdcConfig extends ArcaBaseConfig`:
`cuit` (number|string, check digit validated), `cert`, `key`, `production?`, `timeout?`, `retries?`,
`retryDelayMs?`, `tokenTTLMinutes?`, `onEvent?`, `ticketStorage?`, `clockOffsetMs?`,
`autoClockSkew?`, `loginErrorCooldownMs?`, `fetch?`, `legacyTls?` ('auto'|'never'|'always'),
`endpoints?: { wscdc?: string; wsaa?: string }`.

## Methods (all accept `opts?: { signal?: AbortSignal }`)

- `constatar(input): Promise<ConstatarResult>` - ComprobanteConstatar.
- `status(): Promise<ServerStatus>` - ComprobanteDummy, no auth.
- `getModalidades(): Promise<{ cod: string; desc: string; fchDesde?: string; fchHasta?: string }[]>` - ComprobantesModalidadConsultar (Cod = CAE/CAI/CAEA).
- `getTiposCbte(): Promise<{ id: number; desc: string }[]>` - ComprobantesTipoConsultar.
- `getDocTipos(): Promise<{ id: string; desc: string }[]>` - DocumentosTipoConsultar.
- `getTiposOpcionales(): Promise<{ id: string; desc: string }[]>` - OpcionalesTipoConsultar.
- `clearAuthCache(): Promise<void>`.

```typescript
interface ConstatarInput {           // CmpReq (CmpDatos), sent in WSDL order
  cbteModo: "CAE" | "CAI" | "CAEA";
  cuitEmisor: number | string;
  ptoVta: number;                    // 1..99998
  cbteTipo: number;                  // 1..999
  cbteNro: number;                   // 1..99999999
  cbteFch: string | Date;            // YYYYMMDD | YYYY-MM-DD | Date
  impTotal: number;                  // finite >= 0, rounded to 2 decimals
  codAutorizacion: string;           // 14 digits
  docTipoReceptor?: number | string; // both or neither
  docNroReceptor?: number | string;  // digits only
  opcionales?: { id: string; valor: string }[];
}

interface ConstatarResult {
  resultado: "A" | "R";
  fchProceso: string;
  cmpResp?: { cbteModo: string; cuitEmisor: string; ptoVta: number; cbteTipo: number; cbteNro: number;
              cbteFch: string; impTotal: number; codAutorizacion: string; docTipoReceptor?: string;
              docNroReceptor?: string; opcionales?: { id: string; valor: string }[] };
  observaciones: { code: number; msg: string }[];
  events: { code: number; msg: string }[];
}
```

Semantics:
- `A`: authorized (may include non-blocking observations, e.g. 200).
- `R`: functional rejection, reasons in `observaciones` (100, 102-118, 150-153).
- ARCA `Errors` (format 1-10, auth 600-602, infrastructure 500-503) => throws `ArcaServiceError`
  (ARCA also sets Resultado=R there, but the invoice was not actually checked).
- Missing `resultado`/`fchProceso` => `ArcaSoapError`.

## Errors

Exported: `ArcaError`, `ArcaAuthError`, `ArcaTicketVigenteError`, `ArcaSoapError`,
`ArcaServiceError` (`errors: { code, msg, rawCode? }[]`), `ArcaValidationError`
(`details: { field, message, value }[]`).

## Endpoints

| Environment | WSCDC |
| --- | --- |
| Testing | `https://wswhomo.afip.gov.ar/WSCDC/service.asmx` |
| Production | `https://servicios1.afip.gov.ar/WSCDC/service.asmx` |

Production negotiates 1024-bit DH; works thanks to common's legacy TLS fallback (`legacyTls: 'auto'`).
`servicios1.arca.gob.ar` (listed in the manual) serves a certificate only valid for
`servicios1.afip.gov.ar`.

## Exports

`ArcaCdc`, `CdcClient`, `WsaaClient`, `MemoryTicketStorage`, `FileTicketStorage`,
`validateConstatarInput`, `WSCDC_ENDPOINTS`, `WSCDC_NAMESPACE`, `WSCDC_SERVICE_ID`, `CBTE_MODOS`,
error classes and types (`ArcaCdcConfig`, `ConstatarInput`, `ConstatarResult`,
`ComprobanteConstatado`, `CdcMensaje`, `ModalidadItem`, `TipoCbteItem`, `DocTipoItem`,
`OpcionalTipoItem`, `cbteModo`, `Opcional`, `CdcAuth`, `CallOptions`, `TicketStorage`, ...).
